about: R1's own environment for analysis and offline tokenizers (DECISIONS R1-D5, default 14): the shared generation interpreter gets no packages.

The environment and the tiktoken download cache are git-ignored and never scanned by the neutral-writing check (the venv's scripts carry absolute paths). What is registered here and in the freeze file is what a rebuild must reproduce.
tools/venv_tools_check.py compares the installed environment and the cached encoding files with this record; it downloads and installs nothing.
install: python -m venv .venv-tools; .venv-tools/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --only-binary=:all: numpy scipy statsmodels pandas matplotlib tiktoken pytest (PyPI, binary wheels only; versions resolved at install time and pinned in the freeze file)

tiktoken.how: TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=<repository>/.cache/tiktoken .venv-tools/bin/python -c 'import tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding(NAME)' (tiktoken's default source; the cache file name is the sha1 of the URL). The files are read-only. Local counts read them through runtime/orgene/tokcount.TiktokenCounter, which blocks every download.
